Implementation validated locally per the operator ruling (system-level boundedness):

- Observer re-scoped: tests/_bank_observer.py make_observed_upsert now records the FIRST durable bank write of each criterion regardless of actor (genuine model record OR policy bounded-fallback insufficiency snapshot); only seeded=True cache seeds are excluded. bounded_bank_gaps assertion unchanged (max_gap=3 evidence responses).
- Eval + shared docstrings name the ruled contract (this ticket) and the run-32575679530 evidence.
- Unit regressions (tests/unit/test_completion_banking_oracle.py, real CompletionEvidencePolicy driven by a stubbed toolset):
  * fallback-only transcript GREEN: model never records; fallbacks bank all 5 at snapshots [2,5,8,11,14], gaps <=3.
  * live-shape GREEN: fallbacks at [2,5] + genuine records at [6,7,8] -> [2,5,6,7,8] (the 32575679530 signature under system scope).
  * genuinely-unbounded RED in FINAL oracle form: _Rig(fallback_banks=False) -> responses_at_bank [6,6,6,6,6], oracle rejects (strict test-modification order satisfied).
  * Mutation checks: (A) dropping the gap bound -> unbounded test fails; (B) reverting the observer to the source=='tool' filter -> actor-agnostic forwarding test fails. Both restored; final form 10/10 green.
- Gates: make lint, make typecheck (mypy 636 files clean), complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0.

VALIDATION LIMIT: the live bedrock arm cannot run locally. Stub replay against the real policy proves the oracle semantics on the proven [2,5,8,...] snapshot schedule; live confirmation lands on the next scheduled/dispatched external-integration run.
